raw.query: WITH replay_noise AS (SELECT MAX(100.0 * (max_p99_ms - min_p99_ms) / min_p99_ms) AS max_replay_band_pct FROM (SELECT experiment, sla_metric, MIN(p99_ms) AS min_p99_ms, MAX(p99_ms) AS max_p99_ms FROM provenance.v_pool_latency WHERE is_current = TRUE AND experiment IN ('a14','a15') GROUP BY experiment, sla_metric) s), policy_contrasts AS (SELECT MIN(100.0 * ABS(a.p99_ms - b.p99_ms) / LEAST(a.p99_ms, b.p99_ms)) AS min_policy_contrast_pct FROM provenance.v_pool_latency a JOIN provenance.v_pool_latency b ON b.is_current = TRUE AND a.experiment = b.experiment AND a.window_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM b.window_name AND a.sla_metric = b.sla_metric AND a.lead_s IS NOT DISTINCT FROM b.lead_s AND a.policy = 'forecast' AND b.policy = 'reactive' WHERE a.is_current = TRUE AND a.experiment IN ('a11','a12')) SELECT ROUND(max_replay_band_pct::numeric, 3) AS max_replay_band_pct, ROUND(min_policy_contrast_pct::numeric, 3) AS min_policy_contrast_pct, (min_policy_contrast_pct > max_replay_band_pct) AS no_policy_contrast_within_band FROM replay_noise CROSS JOIN policy_contrasts
